research_findings.name: Channel Battle air operations
research_findings.claim: RAF Museum describes attacks over the Channel, Dover Straits and south-east coast during 17 July–12 August 1940. These are operating regions, not fixed cleared lanes.
research_findings.remaining_gap: Individual sortie tracks, dimensions and clearance boundaries remain unverified. Naval Dunkirk routes X/Y/Z must not be represented as air corridors.

research_findings.name: Marianas–Japan B-29 theater route
research_findings.claim: NHHC places the first Marianas-based Japan attack in late November 1944 and Iwo Jima on the 1945 B-29 theater path. It also describes avoidance before capture.
research_findings.remaining_gap: No single straight centerline or common corridor width is authenticated. Late-1944/1945 routes must not be applied to the default June-1944 setting; Iwo and Japan lie outside the playable map.

research_findings.name: Guam W-517 / R-7201 references
